notes.title: After Steam Next Fest Update!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello, Humans!👽[/b][/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thanks a lot to everyone who engaged with us and our demo during Steam Next Fest, we gathered a lot of feedback and were able to work towards some updates to make sure the experience is closer to what you expect, still there's a lot for us to work on, but we are getting there![/p][p][/p][p]Your opinion helps us shape the game.[/p][p]You can leave your feedback on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/Z2KRRQa7vJ"]Discord server[/url] or in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2646450"]Community Hub[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Try the demo, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to [b]wishlist Who Are You!?[i] [/i][/b]🛸[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed steps sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed general ambience sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing collisions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed translations on different languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed level streaming in certain areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI on Asian Languages[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed interaction prompt[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added small video on intro scene.[/p][/*][*][p]New small interactions added added to the game[/p][/*][*][p]New sounds added to the earthquake scene[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/ca468064aa58786aa3cb86fec75b59fb4b292923.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Key scene on intro level improved.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Live & Major Update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello, Humans!👽[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The demo is now available as part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and we’re excited to finally share it with you!
This update features a [b]new scenario[/b], [b]deeper lore[/b], and [b]more aliens[/b].
Below, you’ll find a detailed devlog describing all the new content we've added.[/p][p][/p][p]Your opinion helps us shape the game.[/p][p]You can leave your feedback on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/Z2KRRQa7vJ" style="button"]Discord server[/url] or in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2646450" style="button"]Community Hub[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Try the demo, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to [b]wishlist Who Are You!?[i] [/i][/b]🛸[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would freeze after clicking a save slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved multiple localization problems across different languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Objects now properly carry over between maps.[/p][/*][*][p]The radio can now be turned off.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several LOD issues for more consistent visual performance.[/p][/*][*][p]Applied texture fixes to various assets.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fully reworked the "Cabin" map and added it to the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a brand new courtyard area to the intro map.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced new interactions in the intro map.[/p][/*][*][p]New languages added:[/p][list][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Italian[/p][/*][*][p]French[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/ca468064aa58786aa3cb86fec75b59fb4b292923.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Optimized performance in the intro map.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced footstep sounds with more immersive versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game design and flow in the "Cabin" map.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new ambient sounds to enhance the atmosphere in the "Cabin" area.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated images in picture frames and polaroids for better visual storytelling.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🔧Devlog 1.0
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽

We’ve just released an update to enhance your experience with the new demo. Below is a list of all the fixes and new features.

We hope you had a wonderful Christmas and wish you a Happy New Year!

See you soon, Human.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the disclaimer did not translate into the selected language.
[*] Improved earthquake effects for enhanced realism and performance.
[*] Enabled physics on several objects that were previously static.
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the main door key from being picked up.
[*] Corrected collisions on the stairs.
[*] Adjusted the LODs (Level of Detail) for various objects.
[*] Fixed an issue where static noise from the TV was audible during the final cutscene.
[*] Corrected significant grammar errors across all supported languages.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added a "Brightness" option for improved accessibility and customization.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/df69b4220bfbcdfc89e384cbb881ee5c45ff7ca7.png[/img]

notes.title: 🔧Update for Fixes & Improvements🔧
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽
We made an update to fix some things in the demo, so here's a short devlog! But first, here's a reminder: [b]any AI voices found in the game are just placeholders while we work setting up all the voice acting.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/af04f0bef47726df23827f46a3a59088378bcd99.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The bug in the maze where you had to die once is now fixed.
[*] Small lightining fixes.
[*] AI works better during the maze level.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/dd056ca1d76448cedddbd1c13b446e60ba85e7a1.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Ray's voice fixed 100%, now all his lines are made by the voice actor.
[*] Intro house modified removing assets that were not needed.
[*] Amy's body can be seen now on the intro.
[/list]

Bear in mind that this is a work in process, we'll keep adding more patches on the demo so you can see it's full potential.

[b]‼️More voice actors joining, so keep an eye on more exciting news‼️[/b]

notes.title: New Demo Out Now‼️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/26d1baf61ed12d748f633a3dd912b96eec7f57de.gif[/img]
Hello, Humans! 👽

The moment you've been waiting for is finally here! The new demo has been released. For those who have been following the game on itch, you may notice that it's one of our biggest updates yet. We've finally included all the remaining voice acting, changed the character models, and improved the game design.

We want to express our gratitude for all the support we've received over the past month. Now, it's time to enjoy the game and save your family!

Enjoy the demo, and thank you for being part of this journey.
